static_traits.name: Lin Fei
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with colleagues affected by Work pressure; Having a few friends to confide in, but they do not fully understand the self-Demands at Work
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; has not received psychotherapy; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Slightly nervous but with clear expression and good organization; higher self-awareness; strong cooperativeness and willingness, actively exploring cognitive patterns and new strategies

basic_info.main_problem: Often feeling overwhelmed at Work, strongly pursuing 'perfection' in tasks, leading to long overtime hours, high sensitivity to mistakes and Anxiety intensified; when things go wrong (e.g., a project not submitted on time), will think one is not a good employee.
basic_info.core_demands: Realizing due to a project not being submitted on time that perfectionism is causing unnecessary pressure and affecting self-image as an employee, hoping to learn better coping through counseling, no longer overly affected by these thoughts.
growth_experiences: A few months ago, a project Lin Fei participated in could not be submitted on time (not her direct responsibility). This event triggered her doubts about own capability and strong perfectionism; afterward she started tasks earlier, extended working hours, repeatedly checking to ensure 'absolute perfection'. This makes her feel high Anxiety and tension daily before important projects or deadlines, and gradually affects relationships with colleagues (more irritable and distant), with Occupational burnout arising and a need for time off. In Social support, although Having a few friends to confide in, they do not fully understand her self-Demands and pressure at Work.

special_situations.event: A few months ago, a project she participated in could not be submitted on time, although not her direct responsibility
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a delay or mistake occurs, it means I am an incompetent employee
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Starting tasks earlier, working overtime, repeatedly checking in pursuit of perfection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This It is all my fault; I am not a good employee

special_situations.event: When facing important projects or approaching deadlines
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only achieving absolute perfection counts as qualified, any flaw equals failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Starts early, extends working hours, over-controls details
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If not perfect, I will fail

special_situations.event: Feeling colleagues do not understand the Work pressure one bears when interacting with them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others cannot understand my pressure, they will negate me and my Work value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces communication, keeps distance from colleagues to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They think I am not good enough/will look down on me

special_situations.event: Small mistakes occur at work or worries about quality arise
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any mistake will lead to serious consequences and prove I am incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Working further overtime, repeatedly revising to eliminate uncertainty
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This will turn into a disaster; my professional image will be ruined

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized as competent, understood, and accepted
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being seen as incompetent, criticized and negated
defense_goal: Avoids failure and criticism by maintaining high standards and perfectionism
Keeps distance from colleagues to reduce the risk of being evaluated
Maintaining a sense of control with longer working hours and Self-monitoring

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough employee who needs perfection to be accepted
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh judges who do not understand oneself (colleagues/superiors)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When an important deadline approaches or others pay attention to work quality and give feedback/questions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding others' attention or Silence as criticism and negation of one's incompetence
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In conversation emphasizes procedures and standards, discusses task details in a calm, rational tone, downplaying personal feelings and vulnerable needs.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When recalling the not-submitted-on-time event or when small mistakes occur currently
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to attribute all responsibility to oneself, and Anticipating others will negate oneself for it
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Self-blame, using harsh self-evaluation and apologetic language, avoiding expressing true emotions and seeking peer support.

manifestations: Reducing communication and becoming distant from feeling colleagues do not understand one's pressure
Shutting themselves off in high-pressure work situations
The inner value condition of 'must/should be absolutely perfect' limits choice and flexibility
Work time is occupied by perfectionism; autonomy in life declines

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Frequently using 'must/should' inner rules, e.g., 'I must make the task absolutely perfect'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Calls herself 'I am often my own harshest critic'
Carefully Repressing feelings in front of colleagues, reducing communication

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Inferring colleagues 'do not understand the pressure I bear', further presuming they will negate oneself

positive_force: Conscientious and highly engaged at work
Willing to seek help and maintain a positive attitude
Able to notice and name cognitive biases (such as black-and-white thinking, personalization), willing to practice restructuring
Has a certain degree of social support (a few friends to talk with)
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as black-and-white thinking, personalization, and catastrophizing
Overtime work and Self-monitoring leading to burnout
Mind-reading inferences about colleagues, leading to alienation and reduced support

target_behavior.behavior: Compulsively pursuing perfection at work and long-term overtime
antecedent: When facing important projects or approaching deadlines
When worrying task quality is not good enough
target_behavior.core_reason: Equating imperfection with failure, fearing being negated; catastrophically predicting potential mistakes to maintain a sense of control
target_behavior.function: Avoids being criticized and failing, gains a sense of control and security

antecedent: When feeling colleagues do not understand one's pressure
The phase of high pressure and approaching deadlines
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing evaluation and negation, interpreting others' reactions as potential criticism
target_behavior.function: Escaping unwelcome evaluations and potential conflict, maintaining fragile self-worth
target_behavior.consequence: Increased sense of loneliness,Decreased support,Interpersonal tension
